description: Search workspace text files with bounded deterministic results.

case_insensitive.description: Match without case distinctions; defaults to false.

context_lines.description: Lines of context before and after each match; defaults to 0.

glob.description: Optional slash-separated glob restricting searched files.

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal text instead of a regular expression; defaults to false.

max_results.description: Maximum matches to return; defaults to 200.

path.description: Workspace-relative file or directory to search; defaults to the workspace root.

pattern.description: Portable regular expression or literal text to find.
